summary_1line: After the Pandavas begin ruling at Indraprastha, Narada visits and warns them to set rules regarding Draupadi, recounting the cautionary tale of Sunda and Upasunda.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Narada stands before the five Pandavas in their royal hall at Indraprastha, warning them to establish rules regarding their shared wife Draupadi.
Draupadi, veiled and reverent, bows at Narada’s feet while the five Pandava brothers watch from their jeweled thrones.
